text:
Maya Patel: Quick postmortem follow-up — propose we add an 'eviction' promptset + a KV-stress load test into the regression gates. Need owners, timelines, and a short chaos drill roster. Who can pick up which bits?

Jon Rivera: +1. I can own the regression gate wiring (CI + alerts). Will need an owner for prompt curation and one for the load harness.

Samir Khan: I can run the chaos drill and the KV stress job. Suggest Wed 10am PT for the drill (small blast radius first). :calendar:

Dana Lee: SRE notes: please include canary rollout steps and repro instructions in the test artifacts. Eviction is often timing-sensitive — add a deterministic seed/path where possible.

Alex Wu: Product request: add a simple user-impact criterion to the evals (e.g., tail-latency > 500ms on 0.1% of requests => fail). That helps prioritize remediations.

Maya Patel: Draft checklist below — can folks confirm ownership + reasonable due dates?
```yaml
regression_gates:
  - id: eviction-promptset
    owner: @MayaPatel
    due: 2024-07-12
  - id: kv-eviction-load
    owner: @SamirKhan
    due: 2024-07-19
  - id: chaos-drill-roster
    owner: @SamirKhan
    due: 2024-07-10
  - id: ci-wiring
    owner: @JonRivera
    due: 2024-07-08
  - id: canary-playbook
    owner: @DanaLee
    due: 2024-07-09
  - id: user-impact-metrics
    owner: @AlexWu
    due: 2024-07-05
```

Jon Rivera: Confirmed ownership for `ci-wiring`. ETA 2024-07-08. I'll add a short checklist PR and link it to the gating job.

Samir Khan: Confirmed chaos drill + kv load. I'll keep initial blast at 5% traffic and run for 15m, then escalate if needed.

Dana Lee: Confirmed canary playbook. I'll add the deterministic repro steps and a rollback checklist.

Alex Wu: I'll define the user-impact metric thresholds and provide example failing cases to seed the promptset.

ci-bot: Created pipeline `regression/eviction-gates` and scheduled nightly runs. Logs will post to #eng-ml-ci.

Maya Patel: Thanks all — I'll open the central tracking ticket and tag the owners. Let's use this thread for quick status updates. :thumbsup:
